context.title: Report
context.description: When the set of reports was created.

context.title: Participants
context.description: Each activity report with its reporting organization and the person it is about: the Member (Professional Profile: unique IDs with their domains, name, licenses).

context.title: Activities
context.description: The activities of each report (provider organization, activity name and ID) and their modules, with the module's Healthcare LOM description and the credits it offers.

context.title: Status and Results
context.description: The individual's status for each module (Registered, Completed, Expired), the registration, start, due, end, completion and expiration dates, the time engaged and the results.

context.title: Credits
context.description: The credit certificates of each module: the credit ID (ccid:providerdomain:localidentifier) and the credit received (accrediting body, certification, type, unit, number of credits, credit focus). Repeat the certificate for each type of credit.

context.title: Point-of-Care Learning
context.description: Point-of-care learning data of an activity: the clinical question or topic, search parameters, resources used and how the learner applied the learning to practice.

context.title: Report
context.description: When the set of reports was created and the reporting period (first and last day) of the data. The arid attribute identifies the document (arid:domain:localidentifier).

context.title: Participants
context.description: Each activity report with its reporting organization and the person it is about: the Member (Professional Profile: unique IDs with their domains, name, licenses), or the Participants: learner demographics (local identifier, state, DEA registration, profession, practice area, time in practice).

context.title: Activities
context.description: The activities of each report (provider organization, activity name and ID, instance ID) and their modules, with the module's Healthcare LOM description and the credits it offers.

context.title: Status and Results
context.description: The individual's status for each activity and module (Registered, Completed, Expired), the registration, start, due, end, completion and expiration dates, the time engaged and the results.

context.title: Credits
context.description: The credit certificates of each module: the credit ID (ccid:providerdomain:localidentifier) and the credit received (accrediting body, certification, type, unit, number of credits, credit focus). Repeat the certificate for each type of credit.

context.title: Regulation and Launch
context.description: The commercial supporter, the launch details (launch action, activity and return location) and the regulatory information of each activity: regulations it complies with or relates to, and regulatory classifications such as Opioid REMS blueprint components.

context.title: Point-of-Care Learning
context.description: Point-of-care learning data of an activity: the clinical question or topic, search parameters, resources used and how the learner applied the learning to practice.
